recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No additional FHIR core action is needed for FHIR-29653; future Observation choice-type search parameter edits should continue avoiding `as` when the input may contain multiple items.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO technical correction asking to replace Observation search parameter FHIRPath expressions that used the FHIRPath `as` type specifier on potentially multi-item collections such as `Observation.component.value`.
initial_application: Commit ee9191ec79 applied FHIR-29653 by changing the affected Observation value and component-value search parameter expressions from `as` to `ofType(...)`; merge commit b5673aa1e3 brought that work into the FHIR history. Later commit 7b140eccee changed the remaining Observation-date `.as(...)` expressions to `.ofType(...)`.
additional_context: `source/fhir.ini` actively lists Observation, so `source/observation/bundle-Observation-search-params.xml` is build-scope source. The originating Zulip thread confirms `ofType(...)` was the intended pattern, OO minutes provide process context, and related FHIRPath issue FHIR-25188 was later resolved no-change because current core uses had already been corrected.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current Observation search parameters use `ofType(...)` for the affected value, component-value, combo-value, and date choice-type expressions, and direct searches found no remaining `as` or `.as(...)` expression in the Observation search parameter bundle.

related_jiras.note: Broader FHIRPath issue about using `as` over collections; ultimately resolved no-change after noting core had already been corrected to `ofType(X)`.
